title: Statistical validation suite for embedding + rerank regression detection
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a statistically-grounded validation suite that produces daily quality scorecards for embedding and reranking endpoints, surfaces regressions with confidence intervals, and integrates with alerting and PR workflows. This suite will combine curated human-labeled corpora, stratified sampling for latency buckets, synthetic perturbations, and time-series drift detectors. Outputs: nightly scorecards, auto-created incidents when metric regressions exceed thresholds, and a small lightweight CLI to run local quickchecks before merging embedding/rerank model changes.
acceptance_criteria: Nightly job produces a JSON scorecard with at least these metrics: MRR@10, nDCG@10, precision@1, recall@K, embedding distance calibration (cosine shift), and paired-significance p-value between current and baseline.
Scorecard includes latency stratification: p50/p90 token generation and end-to-end rerank latency per shard.
Automated alerts defined: threshold-based (absolute) and regression-based (relative with bootstrap CI) that create a ticket and post to #infra-embeddings when triggered.
CLI 'embed-validate quickcheck' runs a 200-sample smoke test in under 2 minutes and returns pass/fail and simple diffs for top-k rerank outputs.
Integration with PR process: a GitHub check that runs the quickcheck and attaches the scorecard link when embeddings/rerank config files change.
Dashboard in Console that shows historical metrics and drift decomposition by dataset slice and latency bucket.
Runbook for on-call: explanation of common false positives, how to rebaseline goldset, and steps to roll back model variants to a fallback.
Documentation page in Confluence with dataset stewardship guidelines and labeling rubric.
End-to-end tests for the nightly pipeline and a small synthetic perturbation suite to validate detectors.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Build canonical scorecard schema and nightly runner (batch Spark job -> scoring service) using existing embedding eval infra as a base.

Phase 2: Curate validation corpora: (a) small human-verified core set (2000 queries across domains), (b) stratified latency slices from production traces, (c) synthetic perturbation generators (typos, paraphrases, adversarial negation).
Phase 3: Instrument rerank endpoints to capture top-k outputs and token-latencies for sampled requests; store samples in S3 with tags for slice and model-variant.
Phase 4: Implement statistical tests: bootstrap CI for mean differences, paired Wilcoxon/Mann-Whitney when appropriate, and Kendall/MRR correlation checks for rerank stability.

Phase 5: Alerting and automation: implement regression-detector lambda that compares yesterday vs baseline window and opens ENG tickets + posts Slack alerts. Integrate with GitHub checks for pre-merge quickchecks.
Phase 6: Observability and UX: Console dashboard + downloadable scorecard JSONs for auditors; add endpoints for programmatic polling (read-only).
Phase 7: Run internal pilot with two product teams for one month, iterate thresholds and onboarding docs, then promote to default nightly run for all embedding/rerank models.
technical_considerations: Sampling strategy must be cost-aware: use reservoir sampling on production traces to keep required sample set under budgeted S3/compute cost.
Latency-aware slices: bucket samples by observed inference p50/p90 to detect quality-latency tradeoffs introduced by new quantized variants.
Baseline management: support rolling baselines (30-day window) and per-model pinned baselines for release blockers.
False positive mitigation: require both absolute drop and statistically significant paired test before auto-creating high-priority incidents.
Data retention and PII: sampled request payloads must be redacted and follow Private deployment policy; store only tokens + hashed identifiers where necessary.
Performance: nightly job must complete within the 2-hour nightly window; quickcheck must be sub-2 minutes for developer feedback loop.
Cost: estimate additional monthly S3 + compute ~ $1.5k for the core suite initially; include budget in the infra cost center.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Over-alerting on minor variance leads to alert fatigue. Mitigation: use sliding windows and require CI overlap test before raising P1s.
Risk: Goldset stale or biased. Mitigation: implement quarterly goldset review with labelers and rotate in fresh queries from production sampling.
Risk: Increased storage and compute cost. Mitigation: aggressive retention policy and ability to downsample older runs to aggregated statistics only.
Risk: Inconsistent measurements across dedicated vs hosted. Mitigation: include environment tags and require separate baselines per deployment mode.
deliverables: Scorecard schema and nightly runner in repo 'infra/embed-eval'.
Embed-validate CLI with quickcheck command in 'tools/embed-validate'.
Console dashboard with historical graphs and dataset slice filters.
GitHub check integration and example workflow for PRs modifying models/config.
Confluence doc: 'Embedding & Rerank Validation Playbook' with stewarding guidelines.
